calc_formation_energy: calculate formation energy per atom from a pymatgen entry and elemental reference energies
calc_cohesive_energy: calculate cohesive energy per atom using isolated atom reference energies and a composition string
calc_energy_from_structure: calculate relative energy per atom from a pymatgen Structure object and total energy value
calc_energy_from_composition: calculate relative energy per atom from a pymatgen Composition object and reference energies
calc_energy_from_entry_dict: calculate relative energy per atom from an entry dict with energy and composition keys
